content: {"phoneNote":"Phone hero is text-only with a dead band between the cenik link and the arched photos, so the salon's pictures only appear at the bottom of the first screen while the whole page runs as long stacked lists.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works well with arched photos and the oversized 'Mia' watermark, but the price and services sections below sprawl across the full 1280px width with little rhythm and large empty bands.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Phone hero: pull the arched photos up directly under the intro text (or place one beside the headline) and remove the empty gap above them so imagery is visible on the first screen.","Desktop prices: constrain to a tighter grid or card row so 'od 85 € Balayage' is not orphaned on a second line with a large blank band below it.","Tighten vertical padding in 'Kdaj nas obiščete' and 'Ljudje v salonu' on both viewports; the pink bands are mostly empty around a few lines of text."],"blockers":[]}
